name: Towers and Bunkers
summary: Corporal Teeka Bloodsnarl in the Alterac Mountains asks you to capture an enemy tower in Alterac Valley. The valley's defenses are at stake.

sections.title: The Assignment
sections.body: An enemy tower in Alterac Valley is the prize Corporal Teeka Bloodsnarl sets before you. Capture it, then return to her in the Alterac Mountains. The order leaves the tower's hold in question.

faq.answer: Corporal Teeka Bloodsnarl gives the order in the Alterac Mountains.
Teeka asks you to capture an enemy tower in Alterac Valley.
After capturing an enemy tower, return to Corporal Teeka Bloodsnarl in the Alterac Mountains.

attribution: In-game quest text: Towers and Bunkers
